definitions.explanation: a chronic respiratory condition characterized by difficulty breathing, wheezing, and coughing, caused by inflammation and narrowing of the airways

examples.japanese: {喘息|ぜんそく}の{発作|ほっさ}が{起|お}きた。
{子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}から{喘息|ぜんそく}を{持|も}っている。
{喘息|ぜんそく}の{薬|くすり}を{常備|じょうび}している。
examples.english: I always keep asthma medication on hand.

notes:
{喘息|ぜんそく} means asthma — a chronic respiratory condition. Composed of {喘|ぜん} (wheeze, pant) + {息|そく} (breath).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {喘息|ぜんそく}の{発作|ほっさ}: asthma attack
- {喘息|ぜんそく}の{薬|くすり}: asthma medication
- {喘息|ぜんそく}{持|も}ち: someone who has asthma
- {喘息|ぜんそく}を{患|わずら}う: to suffer from asthma

TYPES:
- {気管支|きかんし}{喘息|ぜんそく}: bronchial asthma
- {小児|しょうに}{喘息|ぜんそく}: childhood asthma
- アレルギー{性|せい}{喘息|ぜんそく}: allergic asthma

RELATED WORDS:
- {吸入器|きゅうにゅうき}: inhaler
- {発作|ほっさ}: attack/episode
- {呼吸困難|こきゅうこんなん}: difficulty breathing
